#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Synaptic Cartography — Academic Conference Poster (Refined)
Nature 2024 Neural Circuit Mapping Study
Second pass: enhanced visuals, better spacing, richer texture, filled canvas
"""

import math
import random
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter

random.seed(42)

W, H = 4960, 7016
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 70

# --- Color Palette ---
BG_DEEP = (10, 15, 32)
BG_PANEL = (16, 24, 48)
BG_CARD = (22, 32, 58)
ELECTRIC_BLUE = (40, 140, 255)
ELECTRIC_BLUE_DIM = (25, 80, 160)
TEAL = (0, 210, 200)
TEAL_DIM = (0, 120, 115)
GOLD = (255, 195, 50)
WARM_GOLD = (255, 210, 90)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE = (230, 235, 245)
LIGHT_GRAY = (185, 195, 215)
MID_GRAY = (115, 135, 165)
DIM_GRAY = (65, 80, 105)
FAINT = (35, 48, 78)
FAINT2 = (28, 38, 65)
RULE_COLOR = (45, 62, 105)
RULE_BRIGHT = (55, 75, 130)

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def load_font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONT_DIR}/{name}", size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

# --- Fonts ---
font_title_lg = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 178)
font_subtitle = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
font_citation = load_font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_section_head = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
font_metric_val = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 155)
font_metric_label = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_body = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_body_bold = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_mono = load_font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_small = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
font_small_bold = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
font_tiny = load_font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
font_tiny_label = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
font_pipeline_label = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
font_pipeline_desc = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
font_finding_val = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
font_step_num = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)

# Create base image
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_DEEP)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)


# === UTILITY ===

def draw_hline(y, x1=MARGIN, x2=None, color=RULE_COLOR, width=2):
    if x2 is None: x2 = W - MARGIN
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def draw_vline(x, y1, y2, color=RULE_COLOR, width=2):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=color, width=width)

def tw(text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def text_c(y, text, font, color=WHITE, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    draw.text((cx - tw(text, font) // 2, y), text, fill=color, font=font)

def rrect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, outline=None, ow=2):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, font, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{cur} {word}".strip()
        if tw(test, font) <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines


# === BACKGROUND: Dense neural network pattern ===

def draw_neural_bg():
    """Dense scattered nodes with organic connection lines."""
    # Layer 1: Very faint large circles (out-of-focus neural bodies)
    for _ in range(80):
        x = random.randint(-100, W + 100)
        y = random.randint(-100, H + 100)
        r = random.randint(20, 60)
        c = random.choice([(15, 22, 48), (18, 28, 55), (12, 20, 42)])
        draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=c)

    # Layer 2: Medium dots (dendrite cross-sections)
    nodes = []
    for _ in range(900):
        x = random.randint(0, W)
        y = random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(1, 4)
        c = random.choice([
            (30, 55, 100), (25, 65, 90), (20, 50, 80),
            (35, 60, 110), (30, 70, 95)
        ])
        draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=c)
        nodes.append((x, y))

    # Layer 3: Faint connections between nearby nodes
    for i in range(0, len(nodes), 2):
        best_d = 999999
        best_j = -1
        for j in range(max(0, i - 12), min(len(nodes), i + 12)):
            if i == j: continue
            d = math.hypot(nodes[j][0] - nodes[i][0], nodes[j][1] - nodes[i][1])
            if d < best_d and d < 250:
                best_d = d
                best_j = j
        if best_j >= 0:
            c = random.choice([(25, 40, 72), (22, 45, 68), (28, 42, 75)])
            draw.line([nodes[i], nodes[best_j]], fill=c, width=1)

    # Layer 4: Bright accent dots (sparse)
    for _ in range(60):
        x = random.randint(0, W)
        y = random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(2, 5)
        c = random.choice([ELECTRIC_BLUE_DIM, TEAL_DIM, (50, 45, 30)])
        draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=c)

draw_neural_bg()


# === DECORATIVE: Grid of tiny dots (systematic texture) ===

def draw_grid_dots():
    """Faint orthogonal dot grid suggesting systematic observation."""
    spacing = 80
    for gx in range(MARGIN // 2, W - MARGIN // 2, spacing):
        for gy in range(0, H, spacing):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                draw.ellipse([gx, gy, gx + 2, gy + 2], fill=(25, 35, 60))

draw_grid_dots()


# ============================================================
# CONTENT RENDERING
# ============================================================

y = MARGIN

# === TOP ACCENT RULE ===
draw_hline(y, color=ELECTRIC_BLUE, width=5)
y += 40

# === NATURE CITATION BADGE ===
badge = "NATURE   2024   DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
bw = tw(badge, font_citation)
bx = W // 2 - bw // 2 - 35
rrect(bx, y, bw + 70, 56, 8, fill=BG_CARD, outline=ELECTRIC_BLUE_DIM, ow=2)
draw.text((bx + 35, y + 8), badge, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=font_citation)
y += 100

# === TITLE ===
t1 = "MAPPING NEURAL CIRCUIT"
t2 = "ARCHITECTURE"
text_c(y, t1, font_title_lg, WHITE)
y += 190
text_c(y, t2, font_title_lg, ELECTRIC_BLUE)
y += 200

# === SUBTITLE ===
sub = "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis Through Large-Scale Connectomics"
text_c(y, sub, font_subtitle, LIGHT_GRAY)
y += 90

draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=2)
y += 50


# === METRICS BANNER ===

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "NEURONS MAPPED", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("~54M", "SYNAPTIC CONNECTIONS", TEAL),
    ("37", "CIRCUIT MOTIFS", GOLD),
    ("94.2%", "CLASSIFICATION ACCURACY", WARM_GOLD),
]

banner_h = 290
rrect(MARGIN, y, W - 2 * MARGIN, banner_h, 16, fill=BG_PANEL, outline=RULE_COLOR, ow=2)

# Subtle inner glow line at top of banner
draw_hline(y + 3, MARGIN + 16, W - MARGIN - 16, color=FAINT2, width=1)

col_w = (W - 2 * MARGIN) // 4
for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN + col_w * i + col_w // 2
    text_c(y + 35, val, font_metric_val, color, cx=cx)
    text_c(y + 210, label, font_metric_label, MID_GRAY, cx=cx)
    if i < 3:
        sx = MARGIN + col_w * (i + 1)
        draw_vline(sx, y + 35, y + banner_h - 35, color=FAINT, width=1)

y += banner_h + 50
draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION: BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION ===

def section_hdr(yy, title, color=ELECTRIC_BLUE):
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, yy, MARGIN + 7, yy + 68], fill=color)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 28, yy - 4), title.upper(), fill=WHITE, font=font_section_head)
    return yy + 88

content_w = W - 2 * MARGIN

y = section_hdr(y, "Background & Motivation")

bg_text = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural connectivity. "
    "While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field has long lacked the resolution "
    "and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level wiring diagrams. Recent advances in electron microscopy, "
    "automated segmentation, and computational neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. "
    "This study represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze neural circuits at unprecedented scale, "
    "bridging the gap between structural connectivity and functional organization."
)

for line in wrap(bg_text, font_body, content_w - 20):
    draw.text((MARGIN + 10, y), line, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=font_body)
    y += 58
y += 35

draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION: METHODOLOGY PIPELINE ===

y = section_hdr(y, "Methodology", TEAL)
y += 10

steps = [
    ("01", "IMAGING", "Serial-section EM\n4nm x 4nm x 30nm", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("02", "SEGMENTATION", "Deep learning tracing\n+ human proofreading", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("03", "SYNAPSE\nDETECTION", "CNN classifier\n94.2% accuracy", TEAL),
    ("04", "CIRCUIT\nANALYSIS", "Graph-theoretic motifs\nClustering algorithms", GOLD),
    ("05", "VALIDATION", "Calcium imaging\nOptogenetic perturbation", WARM_GOLD),
]

step_w = (content_w - 4 * 32) // 5
step_h = 255
sx_start = MARGIN

for i, (num, title, desc, color) in enumerate(steps):
    sx = sx_start + i * (step_w + 32)

    # Card
    rrect(sx, y, step_w, step_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, outline=color, ow=2)

    # Top accent line inside card
    draw.rectangle([sx + 2, y + 2, sx + step_w - 2, y + 6], fill=color)

    # Step number
    draw.text((sx + 20, y + 18), num, fill=color, font=font_step_num)

    # Title
    ty = y + 88
    for tl in title.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=font_pipeline_label)
        ty += 40

    # Description lines
    dy = y + 178
    for dl in desc.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, dy), dl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=font_pipeline_desc)
        dy += 36

    # Arrow
    if i < 4:
        ax = sx + step_w + 4
        ay = y + step_h // 2
        draw.line([(ax, ay), (ax + 22, ay)], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.polygon([(ax + 18, ay - 8), (ax + 30, ay), (ax + 18, ay + 8)], fill=color)

y += step_h + 50
draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION: KEY FINDINGS (primary section — most real estate) ===

y = section_hdr(y, "Key Findings", GOLD)
y += 10

findings = [
    {
        "val": "37", "unit": "DISTINCT MOTIFS", "color": GOLD,
        "title": "Connectivity Motifs as Building Blocks",
        "body": "Identified as recurring circuit elements suggesting a modular wiring logic — analogous to logic gates in digital circuits, revealing a finite vocabulary of neural computation."
    },
    {
        "val": "3.5%", "unit": "HUB NEURONS  \u2192  28% OUTPUT", "color": ELECTRIC_BLUE,
        "title": "Disproportionate Synaptic Influence",
        "body": "Hub neurons comprising only 3.5% of the population accounted for over 28% of total synaptic output — a highly non-uniform distribution of influence across the network."
    },
    {
        "val": "4.7:1", "unit": "RECURRENT RATIO", "color": TEAL,
        "title": "Layer-Specific Connectivity Rules",
        "body": "Feedforward connections dominated between layers 2/3 \u2192 4, while recurrent connections were enriched within layer 5 at a 4.7:1 recurrent-to-feedforward ratio."
    },
    {
        "val": "6.2\u00d7", "unit": "SPECIFICITY", "color": WARM_GOLD,
        "title": "Inhibitory Wiring Precision",
        "body": "Inhibitory interneurons formed connections with 6.2\u00d7 higher specificity than excitatory neurons, challenging assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage."
    },
]

card_w = (content_w - COL_GAP) // 2
card_h = 380

for idx, f in enumerate(findings):
    col = idx % 2
    row = idx // 2
    cx = MARGIN if col == 0 else MARGIN + card_w + COL_GAP
    cy = y + row * (card_h + 35)

    rrect(cx, cy, card_w, card_h, 14, fill=BG_PANEL, outline=f["color"], ow=3)

    # Top accent stripe
    draw.rectangle([cx + 3, cy + 3, cx + card_w - 3, cy + 7], fill=f["color"])

    # Value + unit
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 28), f["val"], fill=f["color"], font=font_finding_val)
    vw = tw(f["val"], font_finding_val)
    draw.text((cx + 40 + vw + 18, cy + 48), f["unit"], fill=DIM_GRAY, font=font_tiny)

    # Title

    # Body
    by = cy + 175
    for bl in wrap(f["body"], font_body, card_w - 80):
        draw.text((cx + 40, by), bl, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=font_body)
        by += 56

y += 2 * (card_h + 35) + 30

draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION: IMPLICATIONS & FUTURE DIRECTIONS ===

y = section_hdr(y, "Implications & Future Directions", TEAL)
y += 10

implications = [
    ("Modular Circuit Vocabulary", TEAL,
     "The brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements — modular connectivity motifs functioning as computational building blocks, analogous to logic gates in engineered systems."),
    ("Hub Neuron Significance", ELECTRIC_BLUE,
     "Hub neurons as disproportionate drivers of network activity have direct implications for understanding focal lesions and targeted stimulation — relevant to neurological disease and brain-computer interfaces."),
    ("Open-Access Dataset", GOLD,
     "The complete connectomic dataset and analysis tools have been released as open-access resources, expected to accelerate discovery and enable cross-species comparative studies."),
]

imp_w = (content_w - 2 * COL_GAP) // 3
imp_h = 370

for i, (title, color, body) in enumerate(implications):
    ix = MARGIN + i * (imp_w + COL_GAP)

    rrect(ix, y, imp_w, imp_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, outline=RULE_COLOR, ow=2)

    # Accent bar at top
    draw.rectangle([ix + 2, y + 2, ix + imp_w - 2, y + 5], fill=color)

    # Title
    ty = y + 30
    for tl in wrap(title, font_body_bold, imp_w - 50):
        draw.text((ix + 25, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=font_body_bold)
        ty += 54

    # Separator line
    draw_hline(ty + 5, ix + 25, ix + imp_w - 25, color=FAINT, width=1)

    # Body
    by = ty + 22
    for bl in wrap(body, font_small, imp_w - 50):
        draw.text((ix + 25, by), bl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=font_small)
        by += 44

y += imp_h + 55


# === QUANTITATIVE SUMMARY STRIP ===

# A compact data row reinforcing key numbers
draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1)
y += 30

summary_items = [
    ("125,000 neurons", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("54 million synapses", TEAL),
    ("37 circuit motifs", GOLD),
    ("94.2% automated accuracy", WARM_GOLD),
    ("4nm imaging resolution", MID_GRAY),
    ("3.5% hub neurons \u2192 28% output", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("4.7:1 recurrence ratio", TEAL),
    ("6.2\u00d7 inhibitory specificity", GOLD),
]

strip_x = MARGIN
for text_str, color in summary_items:
    tw_s = tw(text_str, font_tiny)
    draw.text((strip_x, y), text_str, fill=color, font=font_tiny)
    strip_x += tw_s + 28
    if strip_x + 200 > W - MARGIN:
        strip_x = MARGIN
        y += 38

y += 50


# === FOOTER ===

draw_hline(y, color=ELECTRIC_BLUE, width=4)
y += 25

fl = "Nature (2024)  \u00b7  DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
fr = "Neural Circuit Architecture  \u00b7  Large-Scale Connectomics"
draw.text((MARGIN, y), fl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=font_small)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - tw(fr, font_small), y), fr, fill=MID_GRAY, font=font_small)
y += 55
draw_hline(y, color=ELECTRIC_BLUE, width=5)


# === SAVE ===
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Saved: {W}x{H}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Synaptic Cartography — Academic Conference Poster (Refined)
Nature 2024 Neural Circuit Mapping Study
Second pass: enhanced visuals, better spacing, richer texture, filled canvas
"""

import math
import random
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter

random.seed(42)

W, H = 4960, 7016
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 70

# --- Color Palette ---
BG_DEEP = (10, 15, 32)
BG_PANEL = (16, 24, 48)
BG_CARD = (22, 32, 58)
ELECTRIC_BLUE = (40, 140, 255)
ELECTRIC_BLUE_DIM = (25, 80, 160)
TEAL = (0, 210, 200)
TEAL_DIM = (0, 120, 115)
GOLD = (255, 195, 50)
WARM_GOLD = (255, 210, 90)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE = (230, 235, 245)
LIGHT_GRAY = (185, 195, 215)
MID_GRAY = (115, 135, 165)
DIM_GRAY = (65, 80, 105)
FAINT = (35, 48, 78)
FAINT2 = (28, 38, 65)
RULE_COLOR = (45, 62, 105)
RULE_BRIGHT = (55, 75, 130)

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def load_font(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONT_DIR}/{name}", size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

# --- Fonts ---
font_title_lg = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 178)
font_subtitle = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
font_citation = load_font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_section_head = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
font_metric_val = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 155)
font_metric_label = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_body = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_body_bold = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_mono = load_font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_small = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
font_small_bold = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
font_tiny = load_font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
font_tiny_label = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
font_pipeline_label = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
font_pipeline_desc = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
font_finding_val = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
font_step_num = load_font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)

# Create base image
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_DEEP)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)


# === UTILITY ===

def draw_hline(y, x1=MARGIN, x2=None, color=RULE_COLOR, width=2):
    if x2 is None: x2 = W - MARGIN
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def draw_vline(x, y1, y2, color=RULE_COLOR, width=2):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=color, width=width)

def tw(text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def text_c(y, text, font, color=WHITE, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    draw.text((cx - tw(text, font) // 2, y), text, fill=color, font=font)

def rrect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, outline=None, ow=2):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, font, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for word in words:
        test = f"{cur} {word}".strip()
        if tw(test, font) <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines


# === BACKGROUND: Dense neural network pattern ===

def draw_neural_bg():
    """Dense scattered nodes with organic connection lines."""
    # Layer 1: Very faint large circles (out-of-focus neural bodies)
    for _ in range(80):
        x = random.randint(-100, W + 100)
        y = random.randint(-100, H + 100)
        r = random.randint(20, 60)
        c = random.choice([(15, 22, 48), (18, 28, 55), (12, 20, 42)])
        draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=c)

    # Layer 2: Medium dots (dendrite cross-sections)
    nodes = []
    for _ in range(900):
        x = random.randint(0, W)
        y = random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(1, 4)
        c = random.choice([
            (30, 55, 100), (25, 65, 90), (20, 50, 80),
            (35, 60, 110), (30, 70, 95)
        ])
        draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=c)
        nodes.append((x, y))

    # Layer 3: Faint connections between nearby nodes
    for i in range(0, len(nodes), 2):
        best_d = 999999
        best_j = -1
        for j in range(max(0, i - 12), min(len(nodes), i + 12)):
            if i == j: continue
            d = math.hypot(nodes[j][0] - nodes[i][0], nodes[j][1] - nodes[i][1])
            if d < best_d and d < 250:
                best_d = d
                best_j = j
        if best_j >= 0:
            c = random.choice([(25, 40, 72), (22, 45, 68), (28, 42, 75)])
            draw.line([nodes[i], nodes[best_j]], fill=c, width=1)

    # Layer 4: Bright accent dots (sparse)
    for _ in range(60):
        x = random.randint(0, W)
        y = random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(2, 5)
        c = random.choice([ELECTRIC_BLUE_DIM, TEAL_DIM, (50, 45, 30)])
        draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=c)

draw_neural_bg()


# === DECORATIVE: Grid of tiny dots (systematic texture) ===

def draw_grid_dots():
    """Faint orthogonal dot grid suggesting systematic observation."""
    spacing = 80
    for gx in range(MARGIN // 2, W - MARGIN // 2, spacing):
        for gy in range(0, H, spacing):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                draw.ellipse([gx, gy, gx + 2, gy + 2], fill=(25, 35, 60))

draw_grid_dots()


# ============================================================
# CONTENT RENDERING
# ============================================================

y = MARGIN

# === TOP ACCENT RULE ===
draw_hline(y, color=ELECTRIC_BLUE, width=5)
y += 40

# === NATURE CITATION BADGE ===
badge = "NATURE   2024   DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
bw = tw(badge, font_citation)
bx = W // 2 - bw // 2 - 35
rrect(bx, y, bw + 70, 56, 8, fill=BG_CARD, outline=ELECTRIC_BLUE_DIM, ow=2)
draw.text((bx + 35, y + 8), badge, fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE, font=font_citation)
y += 100

# === TITLE ===
t1 = "MAPPING NEURAL CIRCUIT"
t2 = "ARCHITECTURE"
text_c(y, t1, font_title_lg, WHITE)
y += 190
text_c(y, t2, font_title_lg, ELECTRIC_BLUE)
y += 200

# === SUBTITLE ===
sub = "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis Through Large-Scale Connectomics"
text_c(y, sub, font_subtitle, LIGHT_GRAY)
y += 90

draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=2)
y += 50


# === METRICS BANNER ===

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "NEURONS MAPPED", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("~54M", "SYNAPTIC CONNECTIONS", TEAL),
    ("37", "CIRCUIT MOTIFS", GOLD),
    ("94.2%", "CLASSIFICATION ACCURACY", WARM_GOLD),
]

banner_h = 290
rrect(MARGIN, y, W - 2 * MARGIN, banner_h, 16, fill=BG_PANEL, outline=RULE_COLOR, ow=2)

# Subtle inner glow line at top of banner
draw_hline(y + 3, MARGIN + 16, W - MARGIN - 16, color=FAINT2, width=1)

col_w = (W - 2 * MARGIN) // 4
for i, (val, label, color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN + col_w * i + col_w // 2
    text_c(y + 35, val, font_metric_val, color, cx=cx)
    text_c(y + 210, label, font_metric_label, MID_GRAY, cx=cx)
    if i < 3:
        sx = MARGIN + col_w * (i + 1)
        draw_vline(sx, y + 35, y + banner_h - 35, color=FAINT, width=1)

y += banner_h + 50
draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION: BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION ===

def section_hdr(yy, title, color=ELECTRIC_BLUE):
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, yy, MARGIN + 7, yy + 68], fill=color)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 28, yy - 4), title.upper(), fill=WHITE, font=font_section_head)
    return yy + 88

content_w = W - 2 * MARGIN

y = section_hdr(y, "Background & Motivation")

bg_text = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural connectivity. "
    "While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field has long lacked the resolution "
    "and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level wiring diagrams. Recent advances in electron microscopy, "
    "automated segmentation, and computational neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. "
    "This study represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze neural circuits at unprecedented scale, "
    "bridging the gap between structural connectivity and functional organization."
)

for line in wrap(bg_text, font_body, content_w - 20):
    draw.text((MARGIN + 10, y), line, fill=LIGHT_GRAY, font=font_body)
    y += 58
y += 35

draw_hline(y, color=RULE_COLOR, width=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION: METHODOLOGY PIPELINE ===

y = section_hdr(y, "Methodology", TEAL)
y += 10

steps = [
    ("01", "IMAGING", "Serial-section EM\n4nm x 4nm x 30nm", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("02", "SEGMENTATION", "Deep learning tracing\n+ human proofreading", ELECTRIC_BLUE),
    ("03", "SYNAPSE\nDETECTION", "CNN classifier\n94.2% accuracy", TEAL),
    ("04", "CIRCUIT\nANALYSIS", "Graph-theoretic motifs\nClustering algorithms", GOLD),
    ("05", "VALIDATION", "Calcium imaging\nOptogenetic perturbation", WARM_GOLD),
]

step_w = (content_w - 4 * 32) // 5
step_h = 255
sx_start = MARGIN

for i, (num, title, desc, color) in enumerate(steps):
    sx = sx_start + i * (step_w + 32)

    # Card
    rrect(sx, y, step_w, step_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, outline=color, ow=2)

    # Top accent line inside card
    draw.rectangle([sx + 2, y + 2, sx + step_w - 2, y + 6], fill=color)

    # Step number
    draw.text((sx + 20, y + 18), num, fill=color, font=font_step_num)

    # Title
    ty = y + 88
    for tl in title.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=font_pipeline_label)
        ty += 40

    # Description lines
    dy = y + 178
    for dl in desc.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, dy), dl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=font_pipeline_desc)
        dy += 36

    # Arrow
    if i < 4:
        ax = sx + step_w + 4
        ay = y + step_h // 2
        draw.line([(ax, ay), (ax + 22, ay)], fill=color, width=2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Synaptic Cartography — Academic Conference Poster (Final)
Nature 2024 Neural Circuit Mapping Study
Third pass: visual richness, glow effects, neural branching, pristine composition

import math
import random
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter, ImageChops

random.seed(42)

W, H = 4960, 7016
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 70

# --- Palette ---
BG_DEEP = (10, 15, 32)
BG_PANEL = (16, 24, 48)
BG_CARD = (22, 32, 58)
BG_CARD_HOVER = (26, 38, 68)
ELECTRIC = (40, 140, 255)
ELEC_DIM = (25, 80, 160)
ELEC_GLOW = (30, 100, 200)
TEAL = (0, 210, 200)
TEAL_DIM = (0, 100, 95)
GOLD = (255, 195, 50)
WARM_GOLD = (255, 210, 90)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE = (228, 233, 244)
LT_GRAY = (185, 195, 215)
MID_GRAY = (115, 135, 165)
DIM_GRAY = (65, 80, 105)
FAINT = (35, 48, 78)
FAINT2 = (25, 35, 60)
RULE = (45, 62, 105)
RULE_BR = (55, 75, 130)

FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def lf(n, s):
    try: return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FDIR}/{n}", s)
    except: return ImageFont.load_default()

# Fonts
f_title = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 178)
f_sub = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
f_cite = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sec = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_mval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 155)
f_mlab = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_body = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_bodyb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_mono = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sm = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_smb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
f_tiny = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_plab = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_pdesc = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_fval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
f_snum = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_DEEP)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def hline(y, x1=MARGIN, x2=None, c=RULE, w=2):
    if x2 is None: x2 = W - MARGIN
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=RULE, w=2):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def _tw(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[2] - bb[0]
def _th(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[3] - bb[1]

def tc(y, t, f, c=WHITE, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    draw.text((cx - _tw(t, f) // 2, y), t, fill=c, font=f)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill, ol=None, ow=2):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=ol, width=ow)

def wrap(t, f, mw):
    words, lines, cur = t.split(), [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if _tw(test, f) <= mw: cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

content_w = W - 2 * MARGIN


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 1: Radial vignette ===

    vig = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
    vd = ImageDraw.Draw(vig)
    cx, cy = W // 2, H // 3
    max_r = int(math.hypot(W, H))
    for r in range(max_r, 0, -4):
        t = r / max_r
        v = int(255 * (1 - t * t * 0.65))
        vd.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(v, v, v))
    from PIL import ImageChops
    result = ImageChops.multiply(img, vig)
    img.paste(result)

draw_vignette()

    nodes = []

        nodes.append((x, y_))

    if depth <= 0 or length < 8: return

    y1 = y0 + math.sin(angle) * length

    r, g, b = color

    fc = (int(r * fade), int(g * fade), int(b * fade))
    draw.line([(x0, y0), (x1, y1)], fill=fc, width=w)
    # Node at junction

        nr = depth
        draw.ellipse([x1-nr, y1-nr, x1+nr, y1+nr], fill=fc)
    spread = 0.4 + random.random() * 0.3

    draw_branch(x1, y1, angle - spread, depth - 1, length * shrink, color)

# Left side branches
for by in range(400, H, 800):

for by in range(600, H, 800):

# ============================================================
# CONTENT
# ============================================================

y = MARGIN

# Top rule
hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=5)
y += 40

# Citation badge
badge = "NATURE   2024   DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
bw = _tw(badge, f_cite)
bx = W // 2 - bw // 2 - 35
rr(bx, y, bw + 70, 58, 10, fill=BG_CARD, ol=ELEC_DIM, ow=2)
draw.text((bx + 35, y + 10), badge, fill=ELECTRIC, font=f_cite)
y += 105

# Title
tc(y, "MAPPING NEURAL CIRCUIT", f_title, WHITE)
y += 190
tc(y, "ARCHITECTURE", f_title, ELECTRIC)

tc(y, "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis Through Large-Scale Connectomics", f_sub, LT_GRAY)
y += 90

hline(y, c=RULE, w=2)

banner_h = 295

gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_layer)
for r in range(300, 0, -3):

hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Synaptic Cartography — Academic Conference Poster (Final)
Nature 2024 Neural Circuit Mapping Study
Third pass: visual richness, glow effects, neural branching, pristine composition
"""

import math
import random
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter, ImageChops

random.seed(42)

W, H = 4960, 7016
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 70

# --- Palette ---
BG_DEEP = (10, 15, 32)
BG_PANEL = (16, 24, 48)
BG_CARD = (22, 32, 58)
BG_CARD_HOVER = (26, 38, 68)
ELECTRIC = (40, 140, 255)
ELEC_DIM = (25, 80, 160)
ELEC_GLOW = (30, 100, 200)
TEAL = (0, 210, 200)
TEAL_DIM = (0, 100, 95)
GOLD = (255, 195, 50)
WARM_GOLD = (255, 210, 90)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE = (228, 233, 244)
LT_GRAY = (185, 195, 215)
MID_GRAY = (115, 135, 165)
DIM_GRAY = (65, 80, 105)
FAINT = (35, 48, 78)
FAINT2 = (25, 35, 60)
RULE = (45, 62, 105)
RULE_BR = (55, 75, 130)

FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def lf(n, s):
    try: return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FDIR}/{n}", s)
    except: return ImageFont.load_default()

# Fonts
f_title = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 178)
f_sub = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
f_cite = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sec = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_mval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 155)
f_mlab = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_body = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_bodyb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_mono = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sm = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_smb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
f_tiny = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_plab = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_pdesc = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_fval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
f_snum = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_DEEP)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def hline(y, x1=MARGIN, x2=None, c=RULE, w=2):
    if x2 is None: x2 = W - MARGIN
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=RULE, w=2):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def _tw(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[2] - bb[0]
def _th(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[3] - bb[1]

def tc(y, t, f, c=WHITE, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    draw.text((cx - _tw(t, f) // 2, y), t, fill=c, font=f)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill, ol=None, ow=2):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=ol, width=ow)

def wrap(t, f, mw):
    words, lines, cur = t.split(), [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if _tw(test, f) <= mw: cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

content_w = W - 2 * MARGIN


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 1: Radial vignette ===

def draw_vignette():
    vig = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
    vd = ImageDraw.Draw(vig)
    cx, cy = W // 2, H // 3
    max_r = int(math.hypot(W, H))
    for r in range(max_r, 0, -4):
        t = r / max_r
        v = int(255 * (1 - t * t * 0.65))
        vd.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(v, v, v))
    from PIL import ImageChops
    result = ImageChops.multiply(img, vig)
    img.paste(result)

draw_vignette()
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)  # refresh draw handle


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 2: Dense neural field ===

def draw_neural_field():
    # Large soft bodies
    for _ in range(100):
        x, y_ = random.randint(-80, W+80), random.randint(-80, H+80)
        r = random.randint(25, 70)
        c = random.choice([(13, 19, 40), (16, 24, 46), (11, 18, 38)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)
    # Small dots
    nodes = []
    for _ in range(1200):
        x, y_ = random.randint(0, W), random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(1, 3)
        c = random.choice([(28, 48, 88), (24, 55, 82), (20, 42, 72), (32, 52, 95)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)
        nodes.append((x, y_))
    # Connections
    for i in range(0, len(nodes), 3):
        for j in range(max(0, i-8), min(len(nodes), i+8)):
            if i == j: continue
            d = math.hypot(nodes[j][0]-nodes[i][0], nodes[j][1]-nodes[i][1])
            if d < 180 and random.random() < 0.4:
                c = random.choice([(22, 36, 64), (20, 40, 60), (25, 38, 68)])
                draw.line([nodes[i], nodes[j]], fill=c, width=1)
                break
    # Bright accent nodes (sparse)
    for _ in range(40):
        x, y_ = random.randint(0, W), random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(2, 5)
        c = random.choice([ELEC_DIM, TEAL_DIM, (55, 50, 35)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)

draw_neural_field()


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 3: Faint grid dots ===

for gx in range(MARGIN//2, W - MARGIN//2, 80):
    for gy in range(0, H, 80):
        if random.random() < 0.25:
            draw.ellipse([gx, gy, gx+2, gy+2], fill=(22, 30, 52))


# === DECORATIVE: Neural branching motif (left/right margins) ===

def draw_branch(x0, y0, angle, depth, length, color):
    if depth <= 0 or length < 8: return
    x1 = x0 + math.cos(angle) * length
    y1 = y0 + math.sin(angle) * length
    w = max(1, depth)
    r, g, b = color
    fade = max(0.2, depth / 6)
    fc = (int(r * fade), int(g * fade), int(b * fade))
    draw.line([(x0, y0), (x1, y1)], fill=fc, width=w)
    # Node at junction
    if depth > 1:
        nr = depth
        draw.ellipse([x1-nr, y1-nr, x1+nr, y1+nr], fill=fc)
    spread = 0.4 + random.random() * 0.3
    shrink = 0.6 + random.random() * 0.15
    draw_branch(x1, y1, angle - spread, depth - 1, length * shrink, color)
    draw_branch(x1, y1, angle + spread, depth - 1, length * shrink, color)

# Left side branches
for by in range(400, H, 800):
    draw_branch(30, by + random.randint(-100, 100), 0.2, 5, 80 + random.randint(0, 40), ELECTRIC)
# Right side branches
for by in range(600, H, 800):
    draw_branch(W - 30, by + random.randint(-100, 100), math.pi - 0.2, 5, 80 + random.randint(0, 40), TEAL)


# ============================================================
# CONTENT
# ============================================================

y = MARGIN

# Top rule
hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=5)
y += 40

# Citation badge
badge = "NATURE   2024   DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
bw = _tw(badge, f_cite)
bx = W // 2 - bw // 2 - 35
rr(bx, y, bw + 70, 58, 10, fill=BG_CARD, ol=ELEC_DIM, ow=2)
draw.text((bx + 35, y + 10), badge, fill=ELECTRIC, font=f_cite)
y += 105

# Title
tc(y, "MAPPING NEURAL CIRCUIT", f_title, WHITE)
y += 190
tc(y, "ARCHITECTURE", f_title, ELECTRIC)
y += 200

# Subtitle
tc(y, "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis Through Large-Scale Connectomics", f_sub, LT_GRAY)
y += 90

hline(y, c=RULE, w=2)
y += 50


# === METRICS BANNER with glow ===

banner_h = 295
banner_y = y

# Glow behind banner
glow_layer = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_layer)
for r in range(300, 0, -3):
    a = int(18 * (1 - r / 300))
    gd.rounded_rectangle(
        [MARGIN - r//2, banner_y - r//3, W - MARGIN + r//2, banner_y + banner_h + r//3],
        radius=20, fill=(30, 80, 180, a)
    )
img_rgba = img.convert("RGBA")
img_rgba = Image.alpha_composite(img_rgba, glow_layer)
img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Banner card
rr(MARGIN, banner_y, W - 2 * MARGIN, banner_h, 16, fill=BG_PANEL, ol=RULE_BR, ow=3)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "NEURONS MAPPED", ELECTRIC),
    ("~54M", "SYNAPTIC CONNECTIONS", TEAL),
    ("37", "CIRCUIT MOTIFS", GOLD),
    ("94.2%", "CLASSIFICATION ACCURACY", WARM_GOLD),
]

col_w = (W - 2 * MARGIN) // 4
for i, (val, lab, c) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN + col_w * i + col_w // 2
    tc(banner_y + 35, val, f_mval, c, cx=cx)
    tc(banner_y + 210, lab, f_mlab, MID_GRAY, cx=cx)
    if i < 3:
        sx = MARGIN + col_w * (i + 1)
        vline(sx, banner_y + 30, banner_y + banner_h - 30, c=FAINT, w=1)

y = banner_y + banner_h + 55
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION HEADER HELPER ===

def sec_hdr(yy, title, color=ELECTRIC):
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, yy, MARGIN + 7, yy + 68], fill=color)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 28, yy - 4), title.upper(), fill=WHITE, font=f_sec)
    return yy + 90


# === BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Background & Motivation")

bg_txt = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural connectivity. "
    "While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field has long lacked the resolution "
    "and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level wiring diagrams. Recent advances in electron microscopy, "
    "automated segmentation, and computational neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. "
    "This study represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze neural circuits at unprecedented scale, "
    "bridging the gap between structural connectivity and functional organization."
)

for line in wrap(bg_txt, f_body, content_w - 20):
    draw.text((MARGIN + 10, y), line, fill=LT_GRAY, font=f_body)
    y += 58
y += 35
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === METHODOLOGY PIPELINE ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Methodology", TEAL)
y += 10

steps = [
    ("01", "IMAGING", "Serial-section EM\n4nm \u00d7 4nm \u00d7 30nm", ELECTRIC),
    ("02", "SEGMENTATION", "Deep learning tracing\n+ human proofreading", ELECTRIC),
    ("03", "SYNAPSE\nDETECTION", "CNN classifier\n94.2% accuracy", TEAL),
    ("04", "CIRCUIT\nANALYSIS", "Graph-theoretic motifs\nClustering algorithms", GOLD),
    ("05", "VALIDATION", "Calcium imaging\nOptogenetic perturbation", WARM_GOLD),
]

step_w = (content_w - 4 * 32) // 5
step_h = 255

for i, (num, title, desc, color) in enumerate(steps):
    sx = MARGIN + i * (step_w + 32)
    rr(sx, y, step_w, step_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, ol=color, ow=2)
    # Top accent
    draw.rectangle([sx + 3, y + 3, sx + step_w - 3, y + 7], fill=color)
    # Number
    draw.text((sx + 20, y + 18), num, fill=color, font=f_snum)
    # Title
    ty = y + 88
    for tl in title.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=f_plab)
        ty += 40
    # Desc
    dy = y + 178
    for dl in desc.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, dy), dl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_pdesc)
        dy += 36
    # Arrow
    if i < 4:
        ax = sx + step_w + 3
        ay = y + step_h // 2
        draw.line([(ax, ay), (ax + 20, ay)], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.polygon([(ax + 16, ay - 8), (ax + 28, ay), (ax + 16, ay + 8)], fill=color)

y += step_h + 50
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === KEY FINDINGS ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Key Findings", GOLD)
y += 10

findings = [
    {"val": "37", "unit": "DISTINCT MOTIFS", "color": GOLD,
     "title": "Connectivity Motifs as Building Blocks",
     "body": "Identified as recurring circuit elements suggesting modular wiring logic \u2014 analogous to logic gates in digital circuits, revealing a finite vocabulary of neural computation."},
    {"val": "3.5%", "unit": "HUB NEURONS  \u2192  28% OUTPUT", "color": ELECTRIC,
     "title": "Disproportionate Synaptic Influence",
     "body": "Hub neurons comprising only 3.5% of the population accounted for over 28% of total synaptic output \u2014 a highly non-uniform distribution of influence across the network."},
    {"val": "4.7:1", "unit": "RECURRENT RATIO", "color": TEAL,
     "title": "Layer-Specific Connectivity Rules",
     "body": "Feedforward connections dominated between layers 2/3 \u2192 4, while recurrent connections were enriched within layer 5 at a 4.7:1 recurrent-to-feedforward ratio."},
    {"val": "6.2\u00d7", "unit": "SPECIFICITY", "color": WARM_GOLD,
     "title": "Inhibitory Wiring Precision",
     "body": "Inhibitory interneurons formed connections with 6.2\u00d7 higher specificity than excitatory neurons, challenging assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage."},
]

card_w = (content_w - COL_GAP) // 2
card_h = 380

for idx, f in enumerate(findings):
    col = idx % 2
    row = idx // 2
    cx = MARGIN if col == 0 else MARGIN + card_w + COL_GAP
    cy = y + row * (card_h + 35)

    rr(cx, cy, card_w, card_h, 14, fill=BG_PANEL, ol=f["color"], ow=3)
    draw.rectangle([cx + 3, cy + 3, cx + card_w - 3, cy + 7], fill=f["color"])

    # Value
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 28), f["val"], fill=f["color"], font=f_fval)
    vw = _tw(f["val"], f_fval)
    draw.text((cx + 40 + vw + 18, cy + 48), f["unit"], fill=DIM_GRAY, font=f_tiny)

    # Title
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 115), f["title"], fill=WHITE, font=f_bodyb)

    # Body
    by_ = cy + 175
    for bl in wrap(f["body"], f_body, card_w - 80):
        draw.text((cx + 40, by_), bl, fill=LT_GRAY, font=f_body)
        by_ += 56

y += 2 * (card_h + 35) + 30
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === IMPLICATIONS & FUTURE DIRECTIONS ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Implications & Future Directions", TEAL)
y += 10

implications = [
    ("Modular Circuit\nVocabulary", TEAL,
     "The brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements \u2014 modular connectivity motifs functioning as computational building blocks, analogous to logic gates in engineered systems."),
    ("Hub Neuron\nSignificance", ELECTRIC,
     "Hub neurons as disproportionate drivers of network activity have direct implications for understanding focal lesions and targeted stimulation \u2014 relevant to neurological disease and brain-computer interfaces."),
    ("Open-Access\nDataset", GOLD,
     "The complete connectomic dataset and analysis tools have been released as open-access resources, expected to accelerate discovery and enable cross-species comparative studies."),
]

imp_w = (content_w - 2 * COL_GAP) // 3
imp_h = 380

for i, (title, color, body) in enumerate(implications):
    ix = MARGIN + i * (imp_w + COL_GAP)
    rr(ix, y, imp_w, imp_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, ol=RULE, ow=2)
    draw.rectangle([ix + 2, y + 2, ix + imp_w - 2, y + 5], fill=color)

    ty = y + 28
    for tl in title.split("\n"):
        draw.text((ix + 25, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=f_bodyb)
        ty += 52
    hline(ty + 8, ix + 25, ix + imp_w - 25, c=FAINT, w=1)

    by_ = ty + 25
    for bl in wrap(body, f_sm, imp_w - 50):
        draw.text((ix + 25, by_), bl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_sm)
        by_ += 44

y += imp_h + 50


# === QUANTITATIVE SUMMARY STRIP ===

hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 28

summary = [
    ("125,000 neurons", ELECTRIC), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("54 million synapses", TEAL), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("37 circuit motifs", GOLD), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("94.2% accuracy", WARM_GOLD), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("4nm resolution", MID_GRAY), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("3.5% hub \u2192 28% output", ELECTRIC), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("4.7:1 recurrence", TEAL), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("6.2\u00d7 inhibitory specificity", GOLD),
]

# Center the strip
total_w = sum(_tw(t, f_tiny) + 20 for t, _ in summary) - 20
sx = W // 2 - total_w // 2
for t, c in summary:
    draw.text((sx, y), t, fill=c, font=f_tiny)
    sx += _tw(t, f_tiny) + 20

y += 50


# === FOOTER ===

hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=4)
y += 28

fl = "Nature (2024)  \u00b7  DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
fr = "Neural Circuit Architecture  \u00b7  Large-Scale Connectomics"
draw.text((MARGIN, y), fl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_sm)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - _tw(fr, f_sm), y), fr, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_sm)
y += 55
hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=5)


# === SAVE ===
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Saved: {W}x{H}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Synaptic Cartography — Academic Conference Poster (Final)
Nature 2024 Neural Circuit Mapping Study
Third pass: visual richness, glow effects, neural branching, pristine composition
"""

import math
import random
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter, ImageChops

random.seed(42)

W, H = 4960, 7016
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 70

# --- Palette ---
BG_DEEP = (10, 15, 32)
BG_PANEL = (16, 24, 48)
BG_CARD = (22, 32, 58)
BG_CARD_HOVER = (26, 38, 68)
ELECTRIC = (40, 140, 255)
ELEC_DIM = (25, 80, 160)
ELEC_GLOW = (30, 100, 200)
TEAL = (0, 210, 200)
TEAL_DIM = (0, 100, 95)
GOLD = (255, 195, 50)
WARM_GOLD = (255, 210, 90)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE = (228, 233, 244)
LT_GRAY = (185, 195, 215)
MID_GRAY = (115, 135, 165)
DIM_GRAY = (65, 80, 105)
FAINT = (35, 48, 78)
FAINT2 = (25, 35, 60)
RULE = (45, 62, 105)
RULE_BR = (55, 75, 130)

FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def lf(n, s):
    try: return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FDIR}/{n}", s)
    except: return ImageFont.load_default()

# Fonts
f_title = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 178)
f_sub = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
f_cite = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sec = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_mval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 155)
f_mlab = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_body = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_bodyb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_mono = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sm = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_smb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
f_tiny = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_plab = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_pdesc = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_fval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
f_snum = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_DEEP)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def hline(y, x1=MARGIN, x2=None, c=RULE, w=2):
    if x2 is None: x2 = W - MARGIN
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=RULE, w=2):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def _tw(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[2] - bb[0]
def _th(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[3] - bb[1]

def tc(y, t, f, c=WHITE, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    draw.text((cx - _tw(t, f) // 2, y), t, fill=c, font=f)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill, ol=None, ow=2):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=ol, width=ow)

def wrap(t, f, mw):
    words, lines, cur = t.split(), [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if _tw(test, f) <= mw: cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

content_w = W - 2 * MARGIN


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 1: Radial vignette ===

def draw_vignette():
    vig = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
    vd = ImageDraw.Draw(vig)
    cx, cy = W // 2, H // 3
    max_r = int(math.hypot(W, H))
    for r in range(max_r, 0, -4):
        t = r / max_r
        v = int(255 * (1 - t * t * 0.65))
        vd.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(v, v, v))
    from PIL import ImageChops
    result = ImageChops.multiply(img, vig)
    img.paste(result)

draw_vignette()
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)  # refresh draw handle


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 2: Dense neural field ===

def draw_neural_field():
    # Large soft bodies
    for _ in range(100):
        x, y_ = random.randint(-80, W+80), random.randint(-80, H+80)
        r = random.randint(25, 70)
        c = random.choice([(13, 19, 40), (16, 24, 46), (11, 18, 38)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)
    # Small dots
    nodes = []
    for _ in range(1200):
        x, y_ = random.randint(0, W), random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(1, 3)
        c = random.choice([(28, 48, 88), (24, 55, 82), (20, 42, 72), (32, 52, 95)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)
        nodes.append((x, y_))
    # Connections
    for i in range(0, len(nodes), 3):
        for j in range(max(0, i-8), min(len(nodes), i+8)):
            if i == j: continue
            d = math.hypot(nodes[j][0]-nodes[i][0], nodes[j][1]-nodes[i][1])
            if d < 180 and random.random() < 0.4:
                c = random.choice([(22, 36, 64), (20, 40, 60), (25, 38, 68)])
                draw.line([nodes[i], nodes[j]], fill=c, width=1)
                break
    # Bright accent nodes (sparse)
    for _ in range(40):
        x, y_ = random.randint(0, W), random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(2, 5)
        c = random.choice([ELEC_DIM, TEAL_DIM, (55, 50, 35)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)

draw_neural_field()


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 3: Faint grid dots ===

for gx in range(MARGIN//2, W - MARGIN//2, 80):
    for gy in range(0, H, 80):
        if random.random() < 0.25:
            draw.ellipse([gx, gy, gx+2, gy+2], fill=(22, 30, 52))


# === DECORATIVE: Neural branching motif (left/right margins) ===

def draw_branch(x0, y0, angle, depth, length, color):
    if depth <= 0 or length < 8: return
    x1 = x0 + math.cos(angle) * length
    y1 = y0 + math.sin(angle) * length
    w = max(1, depth)
    r, g, b = color
    fade = max(0.2, depth / 6)
    fc = (int(r * fade), int(g * fade), int(b * fade))
    draw.line([(x0, y0), (x1, y1)], fill=fc, width=w)
    # Node at junction
    if depth > 1:
        nr = depth
        draw.ellipse([x1-nr, y1-nr, x1+nr, y1+nr], fill=fc)
    spread = 0.4 + random.random() * 0.3
    shrink = 0.6 + random.random() * 0.15
    draw_branch(x1, y1, angle - spread, depth - 1, length * shrink, color)
    draw_branch(x1, y1, angle + spread, depth - 1, length * shrink, color)

# Left side branches
for by in range(400, H, 800):
    draw_branch(30, by + random.randint(-100, 100), 0.2, 5, 80 + random.randint(0, 40), ELECTRIC)
# Right side branches
for by in range(600, H, 800):
    draw_branch(W - 30, by + random.randint(-100, 100), math.pi - 0.2, 5, 80 + random.randint(0, 40), TEAL)


# ============================================================
# CONTENT
# ============================================================

y = MARGIN

# Top rule
hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=5)
y += 40

# Citation badge
badge = "NATURE   2024   DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
bw = _tw(badge, f_cite)
bx = W // 2 - bw // 2 - 35
rr(bx, y, bw + 70, 58, 10, fill=BG_CARD, ol=ELEC_DIM, ow=2)
draw.text((bx + 35, y + 10), badge, fill=ELECTRIC, font=f_cite)
y += 105

# Title
tc(y, "MAPPING NEURAL CIRCUIT", f_title, WHITE)
y += 190
tc(y, "ARCHITECTURE", f_title, ELECTRIC)
y += 200

# Subtitle
tc(y, "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis Through Large-Scale Connectomics", f_sub, LT_GRAY)
y += 90

hline(y, c=RULE, w=2)
y += 50


# === METRICS BANNER with glow ===

banner_h = 295
banner_y = y

# Glow behind banner
glow_layer = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_layer)
for r in range(300, 0, -3):
    a = int(18 * (1 - r / 300))
    gd.rounded_rectangle(
        [MARGIN - r//2, banner_y - r//3, W - MARGIN + r//2, banner_y + banner_h + r//3],
        radius=20, fill=(30, 80, 180, a)
    )
img_rgba = img.convert("RGBA")
img_rgba = Image.alpha_composite(img_rgba, glow_layer)
img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Banner card
rr(MARGIN, banner_y, W - 2 * MARGIN, banner_h, 16, fill=BG_PANEL, ol=RULE_BR, ow=3)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "NEURONS MAPPED", ELECTRIC),
    ("~54M", "SYNAPTIC CONNECTIONS", TEAL),
    ("37", "CIRCUIT MOTIFS", GOLD),
    ("94.2%", "CLASSIFICATION ACCURACY", WARM_GOLD),
]

col_w = (W - 2 * MARGIN) // 4
for i, (val, lab, c) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN + col_w * i + col_w // 2
    tc(banner_y + 35, val, f_mval, c, cx=cx)
    tc(banner_y + 210, lab, f_mlab, MID_GRAY, cx=cx)
    if i < 3:
        sx = MARGIN + col_w * (i + 1)
        vline(sx, banner_y + 30, banner_y + banner_h - 30, c=FAINT, w=1)

y = banner_y + banner_h + 55
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION HEADER HELPER ===

def sec_hdr(yy, title, color=ELECTRIC):
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, yy, MARGIN + 7, yy + 68], fill=color)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 28, yy - 4), title.upper(), fill=WHITE, font=f_sec)
    return yy + 90


# === BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Background & Motivation")

bg_txt = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural connectivity. "
    "While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field has long lacked the resolution "
    "and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level wiring diagrams. Recent advances in electron microscopy, "
    "automated segmentation, and computational neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. "
    "This study represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze neural circuits at unprecedented scale, "
    "bridging the gap between structural connectivity and functional organization."
)

for line in wrap(bg_txt, f_body, content_w - 20):
    draw.text((MARGIN + 10, y), line, fill=LT_GRAY, font=f_body)
    y += 58
y += 35
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === METHODOLOGY PIPELINE ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Methodology", TEAL)
y += 10

steps = [
    ("01", "IMAGING", "Serial-section EM\n4nm \u00d7 4nm \u00d7 30nm", ELECTRIC),
    ("02", "SEGMENTATION", "Deep learning tracing\n+ human proofreading", ELECTRIC),
    ("03", "SYNAPSE\nDETECTION", "CNN classifier\n94.2% accuracy", TEAL),
    ("04", "CIRCUIT\nANALYSIS", "Graph-theoretic motifs\nClustering algorithms", GOLD),
    ("05", "VALIDATION", "Calcium imaging\nOptogenetic perturbation", WARM_GOLD),
]

step_w = (content_w - 4 * 32) // 5
step_h = 255

for i, (num, title, desc, color) in enumerate(steps):
    sx = MARGIN + i * (step_w + 32)
    rr(sx, y, step_w, step_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, ol=color, ow=2)
    # Top accent
    draw.rectangle([sx + 3, y + 3, sx + step_w - 3, y + 7], fill=color)
    # Number
    draw.text((sx + 20, y + 18), num, fill=color, font=f_snum)
    # Title
    ty = y + 88
    for tl in title.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=f_plab)
        ty += 40
    # Desc
    dy = y + 178
    for dl in desc.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, dy), dl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_pdesc)
        dy += 36
    # Arrow
    if i < 4:
        ax = sx + step_w + 3
        ay = y + step_h // 2
        draw.line([(ax, ay), (ax + 20, ay)], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.polygon([(ax + 16, ay - 8), (ax + 28, ay), (ax + 16, ay + 8)], fill=color)

y += step_h + 50
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === KEY FINDINGS ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Key Findings", GOLD)
y += 10

findings = [
    {"val": "37", "unit": "DISTINCT MOTIFS", "color": GOLD,
     "title": "Connectivity Motifs as Building Blocks",
     "body": "Identified as recurring circuit elements suggesting modular wiring logic \u2014 analogous to logic gates in digital circuits, revealing a finite vocabulary of neural computation."},
    {"val": "3.5%", "unit": "HUB NEURONS  \u2192  28% OUTPUT", "color": ELECTRIC,
     "title": "Disproportionate Synaptic Influence",
     "body": "Hub neurons comprising only 3.5% of the population accounted for over 28% of total synaptic output \u2014 a highly non-uniform distribution of influence across the network."},
    {"val": "4.7:1", "unit": "RECURRENT RATIO", "color": TEAL,
     "title": "Layer-Specific Connectivity Rules",
     "body": "Feedforward connections dominated between layers 2/3 \u2192 4, while recurrent connections were enriched within layer 5 at a 4.7:1 recurrent-to-feedforward ratio."},
    {"val": "6.2\u00d7", "unit": "SPECIFICITY", "color": WARM_GOLD,
     "title": "Inhibitory Wiring Precision",
     "body": "Inhibitory interneurons formed connections with 6.2\u00d7 higher specificity than excitatory neurons, challenging assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage."},
]

card_w = (content_w - COL_GAP) // 2
card_h = 380

for idx, f in enumerate(findings):
    col = idx % 2
    row = idx // 2
    cx = MARGIN if col == 0 else MARGIN + card_w + COL_GAP
    cy = y + row * (card_h + 35)

    rr(cx, cy, card_w, card_h, 14, fill=BG_PANEL, ol=f["color"], ow=3)
    draw.rectangle([cx + 3, cy + 3, cx + card_w - 3, cy + 7], fill=f["color"])

    # Value
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 28), f["val"], fill=f["color"], font=f_fval)
    vw = _tw(f["val"], f_fval)
    draw.text((cx + 40 + vw + 18, cy + 48), f["unit"], fill=DIM_GRAY, font=f_tiny)

    # Title
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 115), f["title"], fill=WHITE, font=f_bodyb)

    # Body
    by_ = cy + 175
    for bl in wrap(f["body"], f_body, card_w - 80):
        draw.text((cx + 40, by_), bl, fill=LT_GRAY, font=f_body)
        by_ += 56

y += 2 * (card_h + 35) + 30
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === IMPLICATIONS & FUTURE DIRECTIONS ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Implications & Future Directions", TEAL)
y += 10

implications = [
    ("Modular Circuit\nVocabulary", TEAL,
     "The brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements \u2014 modular connectivity motifs functioning as computational building blocks, analogous to logic gates in engineered systems."),
    ("Hub Neuron\nSignificance", ELECTRIC,
     "Hub neurons as disproportionate drivers of network activity have direct implications for understanding focal lesions and targeted stimulation \u2014 relevant to neurological disease and brain-computer interfaces."),
    ("Open-Access\nDataset", GOLD,
     "The complete connectomic dataset and analysis tools have been released as open-access resources, expected to accelerate discovery and enable cross-species comparative studies."),
]

imp_w = (content_w - 2 * COL_GAP) // 3
imp_h = 380

for i, (title, color, body) in enumerate(implications):
    ix = MARGIN + i * (imp_w + COL_GAP)
    rr(ix, y, imp_w, imp_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, ol=RULE, ow=2)

hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=4)

y += 55
hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=5)

img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Synaptic Cartography — Academic Conference Poster (Final)
Nature 2024 Neural Circuit Mapping Study
Third pass: visual richness, glow effects, neural branching, pristine composition
"""

import math
import random
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter, ImageChops

random.seed(42)

W, H = 4960, 7016
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 70

# --- Palette ---
BG_DEEP = (10, 15, 32)
BG_PANEL = (16, 24, 48)
BG_CARD = (22, 32, 58)
BG_CARD_HOVER = (26, 38, 68)
ELECTRIC = (40, 140, 255)
ELEC_DIM = (25, 80, 160)
ELEC_GLOW = (30, 100, 200)
TEAL = (0, 210, 200)
TEAL_DIM = (0, 100, 95)
GOLD = (255, 195, 50)
WARM_GOLD = (255, 210, 90)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE = (228, 233, 244)
LT_GRAY = (185, 195, 215)
MID_GRAY = (115, 135, 165)
DIM_GRAY = (65, 80, 105)
FAINT = (35, 48, 78)
FAINT2 = (25, 35, 60)
RULE = (45, 62, 105)
RULE_BR = (55, 75, 130)

FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def lf(n, s):
    try: return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FDIR}/{n}", s)
    except: return ImageFont.load_default()

# Fonts
f_title = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 178)
f_sub = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 54)
f_cite = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sec = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_mval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 155)
f_mlab = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_body = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_bodyb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
f_mono = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_sm = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
f_smb = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 34)
f_tiny = lf("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
f_plab = lf("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
f_pdesc = lf("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
f_fval = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
f_snum = lf("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_DEEP)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def hline(y, x1=MARGIN, x2=None, c=RULE, w=2):
    if x2 is None: x2 = W - MARGIN
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def vline(x, y1, y2, c=RULE, w=2):
    draw.line([(x, y1), (x, y2)], fill=c, width=w)

def _tw(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[2] - bb[0]
def _th(t, f):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f); return bb[3] - bb[1]

def tc(y, t, f, c=WHITE, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    draw.text((cx - _tw(t, f) // 2, y), t, fill=c, font=f)

def rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill, ol=None, ow=2):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=r, fill=fill, outline=ol, width=ow)

def wrap(t, f, mw):
    words, lines, cur = t.split(), [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if _tw(test, f) <= mw: cur = test
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur: lines.append(cur)
    return lines

content_w = W - 2 * MARGIN


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 1: Radial vignette ===

def draw_vignette():
    vig = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), (0, 0, 0))
    vd = ImageDraw.Draw(vig)
    cx, cy = W // 2, H // 3
    max_r = int(math.hypot(W, H))
    for r in range(max_r, 0, -4):
        t = r / max_r
        v = int(255 * (1 - t * t * 0.65))
        vd.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(v, v, v))
    from PIL import ImageChops
    result = ImageChops.multiply(img, vig)
    img.paste(result)

draw_vignette()
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)  # refresh draw handle


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 2: Dense neural field ===

def draw_neural_field():
    # Large soft bodies
    for _ in range(100):
        x, y_ = random.randint(-80, W+80), random.randint(-80, H+80)
        r = random.randint(25, 70)
        c = random.choice([(13, 19, 40), (16, 24, 46), (11, 18, 38)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)
    # Small dots
    nodes = []
    for _ in range(1200):
        x, y_ = random.randint(0, W), random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(1, 3)
        c = random.choice([(28, 48, 88), (24, 55, 82), (20, 42, 72), (32, 52, 95)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)
        nodes.append((x, y_))
    # Connections
    for i in range(0, len(nodes), 3):
        for j in range(max(0, i-8), min(len(nodes), i+8)):
            if i == j: continue
            d = math.hypot(nodes[j][0]-nodes[i][0], nodes[j][1]-nodes[i][1])
            if d < 180 and random.random() < 0.4:
                c = random.choice([(22, 36, 64), (20, 40, 60), (25, 38, 68)])
                draw.line([nodes[i], nodes[j]], fill=c, width=1)
                break
    # Bright accent nodes (sparse)
    for _ in range(40):
        x, y_ = random.randint(0, W), random.randint(0, H)
        r = random.randint(2, 5)
        c = random.choice([ELEC_DIM, TEAL_DIM, (55, 50, 35)])
        draw.ellipse([x-r, y_-r, x+r, y_+r], fill=c)

draw_neural_field()


# === BACKGROUND LAYER 3: Faint grid dots ===

for gx in range(MARGIN//2, W - MARGIN//2, 80):
    for gy in range(0, H, 80):
        if random.random() < 0.25:
            draw.ellipse([gx, gy, gx+2, gy+2], fill=(22, 30, 52))


# === DECORATIVE: Neural branching motif (left/right margins) ===

def draw_branch(x0, y0, angle, depth, length, color):
    if depth <= 0 or length < 8: return
    x1 = x0 + math.cos(angle) * length
    y1 = y0 + math.sin(angle) * length
    w = max(1, depth)
    r, g, b = color
    fade = max(0.2, depth / 6)
    fc = (int(r * fade), int(g * fade), int(b * fade))
    draw.line([(x0, y0), (x1, y1)], fill=fc, width=w)
    # Node at junction
    if depth > 1:
        nr = depth
        draw.ellipse([x1-nr, y1-nr, x1+nr, y1+nr], fill=fc)
    spread = 0.4 + random.random() * 0.3
    shrink = 0.6 + random.random() * 0.15
    draw_branch(x1, y1, angle - spread, depth - 1, length * shrink, color)
    draw_branch(x1, y1, angle + spread, depth - 1, length * shrink, color)

# Left side branches
for by in range(400, H, 800):
    draw_branch(30, by + random.randint(-100, 100), 0.2, 5, 80 + random.randint(0, 40), ELECTRIC)
# Right side branches
for by in range(600, H, 800):
    draw_branch(W - 30, by + random.randint(-100, 100), math.pi - 0.2, 5, 80 + random.randint(0, 40), TEAL)


# ============================================================
# CONTENT
# ============================================================

y = MARGIN

# Top rule
hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=5)
y += 40

# Citation badge
badge = "NATURE   2024   DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
bw = _tw(badge, f_cite)
bx = W // 2 - bw // 2 - 35
rr(bx, y, bw + 70, 58, 10, fill=BG_CARD, ol=ELEC_DIM, ow=2)
draw.text((bx + 35, y + 10), badge, fill=ELECTRIC, font=f_cite)
y += 105

# Title
tc(y, "MAPPING NEURAL CIRCUIT", f_title, WHITE)
y += 190
tc(y, "ARCHITECTURE", f_title, ELECTRIC)
y += 200

# Subtitle
tc(y, "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis Through Large-Scale Connectomics", f_sub, LT_GRAY)
y += 90

hline(y, c=RULE, w=2)
y += 50


# === METRICS BANNER with glow ===

banner_h = 295
banner_y = y

# Glow behind banner
glow_layer = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
gd = ImageDraw.Draw(glow_layer)
for r in range(300, 0, -3):
    a = int(18 * (1 - r / 300))
    gd.rounded_rectangle(
        [MARGIN - r//2, banner_y - r//3, W - MARGIN + r//2, banner_y + banner_h + r//3],
        radius=20, fill=(30, 80, 180, a)
    )
img_rgba = img.convert("RGBA")
img_rgba = Image.alpha_composite(img_rgba, glow_layer)
img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Banner card
rr(MARGIN, banner_y, W - 2 * MARGIN, banner_h, 16, fill=BG_PANEL, ol=RULE_BR, ow=3)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "NEURONS MAPPED", ELECTRIC),
    ("~54M", "SYNAPTIC CONNECTIONS", TEAL),
    ("37", "CIRCUIT MOTIFS", GOLD),
    ("94.2%", "CLASSIFICATION ACCURACY", WARM_GOLD),
]

col_w = (W - 2 * MARGIN) // 4
for i, (val, lab, c) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = MARGIN + col_w * i + col_w // 2
    tc(banner_y + 35, val, f_mval, c, cx=cx)
    tc(banner_y + 210, lab, f_mlab, MID_GRAY, cx=cx)
    if i < 3:
        sx = MARGIN + col_w * (i + 1)
        vline(sx, banner_y + 30, banner_y + banner_h - 30, c=FAINT, w=1)

y = banner_y + banner_h + 55
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === SECTION HEADER HELPER ===

def sec_hdr(yy, title, color=ELECTRIC):
    draw.rectangle([MARGIN, yy, MARGIN + 7, yy + 68], fill=color)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 28, yy - 4), title.upper(), fill=WHITE, font=f_sec)
    return yy + 90


# === BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Background & Motivation")

bg_txt = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural connectivity. "
    "While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field has long lacked the resolution "
    "and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level wiring diagrams. Recent advances in electron microscopy, "
    "automated segmentation, and computational neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. "
    "This study represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze neural circuits at unprecedented scale, "
    "bridging the gap between structural connectivity and functional organization."
)

for line in wrap(bg_txt, f_body, content_w - 20):
    draw.text((MARGIN + 10, y), line, fill=LT_GRAY, font=f_body)
    y += 58
y += 35
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === METHODOLOGY PIPELINE ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Methodology", TEAL)
y += 10

steps = [
    ("01", "IMAGING", "Serial-section EM\n4nm \u00d7 4nm \u00d7 30nm", ELECTRIC),
    ("02", "SEGMENTATION", "Deep learning tracing\n+ human proofreading", ELECTRIC),
    ("03", "SYNAPSE\nDETECTION", "CNN classifier\n94.2% accuracy", TEAL),
    ("04", "CIRCUIT\nANALYSIS", "Graph-theoretic motifs\nClustering algorithms", GOLD),
    ("05", "VALIDATION", "Calcium imaging\nOptogenetic perturbation", WARM_GOLD),
]

step_w = (content_w - 4 * 32) // 5
step_h = 255

for i, (num, title, desc, color) in enumerate(steps):
    sx = MARGIN + i * (step_w + 32)
    rr(sx, y, step_w, step_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, ol=color, ow=2)
    # Top accent
    draw.rectangle([sx + 3, y + 3, sx + step_w - 3, y + 7], fill=color)
    # Number
    draw.text((sx + 20, y + 18), num, fill=color, font=f_snum)
    # Title
    ty = y + 88
    for tl in title.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=f_plab)
        ty += 40
    # Desc
    dy = y + 178
    for dl in desc.split("\n"):
        draw.text((sx + 20, dy), dl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_pdesc)
        dy += 36
    # Arrow
    if i < 4:
        ax = sx + step_w + 3
        ay = y + step_h // 2
        draw.line([(ax, ay), (ax + 20, ay)], fill=color, width=2)
        draw.polygon([(ax + 16, ay - 8), (ax + 28, ay), (ax + 16, ay + 8)], fill=color)

y += step_h + 50
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === KEY FINDINGS ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Key Findings", GOLD)
y += 10

findings = [
    {"val": "37", "unit": "DISTINCT MOTIFS", "color": GOLD,
     "title": "Connectivity Motifs as Building Blocks",
     "body": "Identified as recurring circuit elements suggesting modular wiring logic \u2014 analogous to logic gates in digital circuits, revealing a finite vocabulary of neural computation."},
    {"val": "3.5%", "unit": "HUB NEURONS  \u2192  28% OUTPUT", "color": ELECTRIC,
     "title": "Disproportionate Synaptic Influence",
     "body": "Hub neurons comprising only 3.5% of the population accounted for over 28% of total synaptic output \u2014 a highly non-uniform distribution of influence across the network."},
    {"val": "4.7:1", "unit": "RECURRENT RATIO", "color": TEAL,
     "title": "Layer-Specific Connectivity Rules",
     "body": "Feedforward connections dominated between layers 2/3 \u2192 4, while recurrent connections were enriched within layer 5 at a 4.7:1 recurrent-to-feedforward ratio."},
    {"val": "6.2\u00d7", "unit": "SPECIFICITY", "color": WARM_GOLD,
     "title": "Inhibitory Wiring Precision",
     "body": "Inhibitory interneurons formed connections with 6.2\u00d7 higher specificity than excitatory neurons, challenging assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage."},
]

card_w = (content_w - COL_GAP) // 2
card_h = 380

for idx, f in enumerate(findings):
    col = idx % 2
    row = idx // 2
    cx = MARGIN if col == 0 else MARGIN + card_w + COL_GAP
    cy = y + row * (card_h + 35)

    rr(cx, cy, card_w, card_h, 14, fill=BG_PANEL, ol=f["color"], ow=3)
    draw.rectangle([cx + 3, cy + 3, cx + card_w - 3, cy + 7], fill=f["color"])

    # Value
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 28), f["val"], fill=f["color"], font=f_fval)
    vw = _tw(f["val"], f_fval)
    draw.text((cx + 40 + vw + 18, cy + 48), f["unit"], fill=DIM_GRAY, font=f_tiny)

    # Title
    draw.text((cx + 40, cy + 115), f["title"], fill=WHITE, font=f_bodyb)

    # Body
    by_ = cy + 175
    for bl in wrap(f["body"], f_body, card_w - 80):
        draw.text((cx + 40, by_), bl, fill=LT_GRAY, font=f_body)
        by_ += 56

y += 2 * (card_h + 35) + 30
hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 55


# === IMPLICATIONS & FUTURE DIRECTIONS ===

y = sec_hdr(y, "Implications & Future Directions", TEAL)
y += 10

implications = [
    ("Modular Circuit\nVocabulary", TEAL,
     "The brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements \u2014 modular connectivity motifs functioning as computational building blocks, analogous to logic gates in engineered systems."),
    ("Hub Neuron\nSignificance", ELECTRIC,
     "Hub neurons as disproportionate drivers of network activity have direct implications for understanding focal lesions and targeted stimulation \u2014 relevant to neurological disease and brain-computer interfaces."),
    ("Open-Access\nDataset", GOLD,
     "The complete connectomic dataset and analysis tools have been released as open-access resources, expected to accelerate discovery and enable cross-species comparative studies."),
]

imp_w = (content_w - 2 * COL_GAP) // 3
imp_h = 380

for i, (title, color, body) in enumerate(implications):
    ix = MARGIN + i * (imp_w + COL_GAP)
    rr(ix, y, imp_w, imp_h, 12, fill=BG_CARD, ol=RULE, ow=2)
    draw.rectangle([ix + 2, y + 2, ix + imp_w - 2, y + 5], fill=color)

    ty = y + 28
    for tl in title.split("\n"):
        draw.text((ix + 25, ty), tl, fill=WHITE, font=f_bodyb)
        ty += 52
    hline(ty + 8, ix + 25, ix + imp_w - 25, c=FAINT, w=1)

    by_ = ty + 25
    for bl in wrap(body, f_sm, imp_w - 50):
        draw.text((ix + 25, by_), bl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_sm)
        by_ += 44

y += imp_h + 50


# === QUANTITATIVE SUMMARY STRIP ===

hline(y, c=RULE, w=1)
y += 28

summary = [
    ("125,000 neurons", ELECTRIC), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("54 million synapses", TEAL), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("37 circuit motifs", GOLD), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("94.2% accuracy", WARM_GOLD), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("4nm resolution", MID_GRAY), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("3.5% hub \u2192 28% output", ELECTRIC), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("4.7:1 recurrence", TEAL), ("\u00b7", DIM_GRAY),
    ("6.2\u00d7 inhibitory specificity", GOLD),
]

# Center the strip
total_w = sum(_tw(t, f_tiny) + 20 for t, _ in summary) - 20
sx = W // 2 - total_w // 2
for t, c in summary:
    draw.text((sx, y), t, fill=c, font=f_tiny)
    sx += _tw(t, f_tiny) + 20

y += 50


# === FOOTER ===

hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=4)
y += 28

fl = "Nature (2024)  \u00b7  DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w"
fr = "Neural Circuit Architecture  \u00b7  Large-Scale Connectomics"
draw.text((MARGIN, y), fl, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_sm)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - _tw(fr, f_sm), y), fr, fill=MID_GRAY, font=f_sm)
y += 55
hline(y, c=ELECTRIC, w=5)


# === SAVE ===
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
print(f"Saved: {W}x{H}")
